supplements.relation: Per-load and warning references for RS-WIN, RS-EQX, RS-EQY and RS-EQZ. Use `reference_system_pending_cases` for EQ-6. This generator compares the four analytic resultants and three pipes-only twins coefficient by coefficient with constants transcribed from that package. The maintained test checks those constants against the sibling files. Both use 9.80665 m/s² for seismic gravity. The pending-cases package assumed it, and §8.1 states it.

governs.scope: execution/PKG-05/DEL-05-01/ScopeOfWork.md at aebd3442f: Static-equivalent generation, Mass basis, Self-weight plan, REQ-008, REQ-015, AC-007, VER-005

quoted.gravity_weight: §2: Gravity is entered on each weight case as `global_z`, value −9.80665 m/s²
quoted.seismic: §8.1: Each static seismic case, RS-EQX, RS-EQY and RS-EQZ, enters a gravity acceleration of 9.80665 m/s² as a positive magnitude and one factor on its own axis: `g_factor_x` 0.30, `g_factor_y` 0.30 and `g_factor_z` 0.20 respectively, each positive. The factor's sign is the direction's sign.
quoted.wind: §8.1: RS-WIN | W + P + wind: 0.9 kPa, shape factor 0.7, `global_x`, exposed members RS-P070 … RS-P200 except the replaced span RS-P180
quoted.replaced: §5.1: The replaced span RS-P180 carries no load, member result or self-weight. It is excluded from weight generation and from every primitive load
quoted.rigid: §5: The valve, flanges and reducer are rigid-family components (`mechanics_geometry_only`).
quoted.identifier: §8.1: `load:self-weight:<n>:<case id>:<m>:<pipe id>` for a member's line load, and `load:self-weight:<n>:<case id>:component:<m>:<component id>:force:z` or `…:moment:<axis>` for a component's weight, where `<n>` and `<m>` are the character counts of the id that follows each.
quoted.w_inventory: §8.1: W is generated self-weight of every member except RS-P180 (gravity as §2), with component weights at their centres of gravity in place of their members' distributed weight: 21 line loads on the straight and arc members other than RS-P020, RS-P030, RS-P040 and RS-P150, and a force and a moment for each of RS-F1, RS-V1, RS-F2 and RS-R1, 29 primitives per case.

conventions.moment: sum of r × F over every force at its point of action, plus the component couples
conventions.sign: a positive g-factor and global_x wind load along the positive global axis (spec §8.1: the factor's sign is the direction's sign)
conventions.member: straight: r(s) from its from-node to its to-node; arc: centre C, e1 and e2 the radius vectors to its from- and to-node, length R·π/2, ∫ r ds = R[(π/2)C + e1 + e2]
conventions.exact: a sum of (q)*sqrt(n)*pi^k terms, q rational
conventions.decimal: 40 significant digits, round half even; value: the nearest binary64; each emitted only when both ends of a bounding interval give the same

labels.value_N, value_N_m: analytic values on the entered decimals

mass_basis.name: source_od_nominal_wall_pressure_bore_areas/v1
mass_basis.formula: μ = π[ρ_m(R² − (R − t)²) + ρ_c(R − ((t − c_m) − c_a))² + ρ_i((R + t_i)² − R²)]

EQ-4.reference: validation/references/reference_system_pending_cases/README.md, 'EQ-4: SRSS and absolute sum, an identity' (the operand-row identity)

rule: Compare load kind, target and direction or axis exactly.
Compare every nonzero component force and moment against its recorded binary64 bits.
For zero transverse moments, either sign is valid if a record is emitted.
Compare the remaining nonzero values at 1e-9 relative alone.
For an exact-zero resultant component, use 1e-9 times the largest absolute component in its force or moment vector.
comparison_rule.floors: the eight stored floors use binary64 multiplication of the represented family maximum and the represented 1e-9
comparison_rule.floor_example: RS-EQX's force floor is 1.4010967471694583e-05; rounding the exact analytic product instead gives 1.4010967471694581e-05
comparison_rule.why_bits: single rounding of the three normalized operands changes six moment results by one bit and passes the relative comparison; in RS-EQX, the valve's +234 N·m about Y would be 406d3fffffffffff; the required encoding is 406d400000000000
comparison_rule.source: the relative and zero rule as validation/references/w16_exact_equivalent_static/README.md states it; the pending-cases package leaves tolerances to the consumer
